text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought Admire Groove, who hasn't been 
feeling well lately, to visit a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...A miss again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Make a wish, throw a stone into the hollow 
of the rock, and it will come true. She's 
taking on the challenge, but it's proving 
easier said than done.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I should close my eyes when I 
throw next time.
choice_data_list: Didn't that just get even harder?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that's perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No good. Next time, I'll switch 
throwing hands, too...
choice_data_list:
I think you should just throw it normally, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...In that case, there's no point.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The strength that comes out when I'm 
backed into a cornerâ that is my true 
worth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sun had completely set. The number of 
stones Admire Groove had thrown easily 
exceeded a hundred by now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I will throw from further away.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You can go on home ahead of me, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't gauge her true intentions. Even 
so, as long as the light in her eyes 
hasn't faded, I will choose to believe in 
her.
choice_data_list: ...I'll be watching until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Letting my guard down is why my condition 
is slipping...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...What I lack is resolve.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(This isn't a wish for luck... it's a 
challenge to myself!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pebble arced through the air and began 
its descent toward the rock—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if sucked into it, the stone nestled 
perfectly into the hollow of the rock.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes... I did it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting from this day, Admire Groove got 
back into her groove!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bouncing off a hollow in the rock, the 
stone mercilessly fell to the ground.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Any more than this will affect 
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove was unable to get back in 
top form...
